# Getting help

Start with the [user guides](../README.md#user-guides) for English, 简体中文, 繁體中文 or 日本語. The guides cover the data notice, enable switches, Force Mode, site rules and known limits.

For a bug or compatibility problem, use the [bug report form](https://github.com/fenghuashao/EasyCV/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include:

- EasyCV version and installation source: Chrome Web Store or a local build.
- Browser version, operating system and interface language.
- A public site URL or a minimal example, the steps taken, expected behavior and what happened.
- Whether the issue occurs with EasyCV disabled, and which copy/paste, Force Mode and site-rule settings were active.

Remove account details, private URLs, clipboard contents, cookies and tokens before attaching logs or screenshots. Do not upload browser profiles or complete settings exports containing browsing history or personal domains.

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/fenghuashao/EasyCV/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) for ideas and translation improvements. Response times and website compatibility vary; a report does not imply a scheduled fix.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow the [security policy](./SECURITY.md). For data handling, read the [privacy policy](../PRIVACY.md).
